title: Brazilian Cheese Fritters
description: A delicious and crispy fritter recipe filled with melted Brazilian cheese, great for a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the Brazilian cheese, garlicky zesty seasoning, flour, and eggs.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
